run.idea_text: We built a drone that inspects wind-turbine blades with thermal and RGB cameras and detects defects with an on-board AI model, so operators no longer need rope-access teams. We think the market is worth EUR 5 billion.

reasons: A concrete technology with identifiable B2B customers (wind farm operators and O&M providers).

interpretation.summary: Autonomous drones with thermal and RGB cameras inspect wind-turbine blades and flag defects with an on-board AI model, replacing rope-access inspection teams.
interpretation.technology: Drone-mounted thermal/RGB imaging with on-board defect classification
market_drivers: Ageing onshore wind fleet needs more frequent inspection
Shortage and cost of rope-access technicians

assumptions.text: Half of target organisations have both the need and a budget for automated blade inspection.
A quarter of target organisations adopt drone-based blade inspection within five years.
Customers will pay 50-100% of their current manual inspection spend.
We can win about 5% of adopting organisations within five years.

steps.name: scoping
steps.message: In scope: wind-turbine blade inspection drones
